Whereas Edom<WH0123> saith<WH0559><WTH8799>, We are impoverished<WH07567><WTH8795>, but we will return<WH07725><WTH8799> and build<WH01129><WTH8799> the desolate places<WH02723>; thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, They shall build<WH01129><WTH8799>, but I will throw down<WH02040><WTH8799>; and they shall call<WH07121><WTH8804> them, The border<WH01366> of wickedness<WH07564>, and, The people<WH05971> against whom the LORD<WH03068> hath indignation<WH02194><WTH8804> for<WH05704> ever<WH05769>.

And your eyes<WH05869> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799>, and ye shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, The LORD<WH03068> will be magnified<WH01431><WTH8799> from the border<WH01366> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>from: or, upon: Heb. from upon<Rf><CM>

A son<WH01121> honoureth<WH03513><WTH8762> <FI>his<Fi> father<WH01>, and a servant<WH05650> his master<WH0113>: if then I <FI>be<Fi> a father<WH01>, where <FI>is<Fi> mine honour<WH03519>? and if I <FI>be<Fi> a master<WH0113>, where <FI>is<Fi> my fear<WH04172>? saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635> unto you, O priests<WH03548>, that despise<WH0959><WTH8802> my name<WH08034>. Ye offer<WH05066><WTH8688> polluted<WH01351><WTH8794> bread<WH03899> upon mine altar<WH04196>; and ye say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Wherein have we polluted<WH01351><WTH8765> thee? And if ye offer<WH05066><WTH8686> the blind<WH05787> for sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8800>, <FI>is it<Fi> not evil<WH07451>? and if ye offer<WH05066><WTH8686> the lame<WH06455> and sick<WH02470><WTH8802>, <FI>is it<Fi> not evil<WH07451>? offer<WH07126><WTH8685> it now unto thy governor<WH06346>; will he be pleased<WH07521><WTH8799> with thee, or accept<WH05375><WTH8799> thy person<WH06440>? saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>. <RF>for: Heb. to<Rf>

And now, I pray you, beseech<WH02470><WTH8761><WH06440> God<WH0410> that he will be gracious<WH02603><WTH8799> unto us: this hath been by your means<WH03027>: will he regard<WH05375><WTH8799> your persons<WH06440>? saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>. <RF>God: Heb. the face of God<Rf> <RF>by...: Heb. from your hand<Rf>

Who <FI>is there<Fi> even among you that would shut<WH05462><WTH8799> the doors<WH01817> <FI>for nought<Fi> ? neither do ye kindle<WH0215><WTH8686> <FI>fire<Fi> on mine altar<WH04196> for nought<WH02600>. I have no pleasure<WH02656> in you, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, neither will I accept<WH07521><WTH8799> an offering<WH04503> at your hand<WH03027>.

For from the rising<WH04217> of the sun<WH08121> even unto the going down<WH03996> of the same my name<WH08034> <FI>shall be<Fi> great<WH01419> among the Gentiles<WH01471>; and in every place<WH04725> incense<WH06999><WTH8716> <FI>shall be<Fi>  offered<WH05066><WTH8716> unto my name<WH08034>, and a pure<WH02889> offering<WH04503>: for my name<WH08034> <FI>shall be<Fi> great<WH01419> among the heathen<WH01471>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>.

But ye have profaned<WH02490><WTH8764> it, in that ye say<WH0559><WTH8800>, The table<WH07979> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> polluted<WH01351><WTH8794>; and the fruit<WH05108> thereof, <FI>even<Fi> his meat<WH0400>, <FI>is<Fi> contemptible<WH0959><WTH8737>.

Ye said<WH0559><WTH8804> also, Behold, what a weariness<WH04972> <FI>is it<Fi> ! and ye have snuffed<WH05301><WTH8689> at it, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>; and ye brought<WH0935><WTH8689> <FI>that which was<Fi> torn<WH01497><WTH8803>, and the lame<WH06455>, and the sick<WH02470><WTH8802>; thus ye brought<WH0935><WTH8689> an offering<WH04503>: should I accept<WH07521><WTH8799> this of your hand<WH03027>? saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>and ye have...: or, whereas ye might have blown it away<Rf>

But cursed<WH0779><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the deceiver<WH05230><WTH8802>, which<WH03426> hath in his flock<WH05739> a male<WH02145>, and voweth<WH05087><WTH8802>, and sacrificeth<WH02076><WTH8802> unto the Lord<WH0136> a corrupt thing<WH07843><WTH8716>: for I <FI>am<Fi> a great<WH01419> King<WH04428>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, and my name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> dreadful<WH03372><WTH8737> among the heathen<WH01471>. <RF>which...: Heb. in whose flock is<Rf><CM>
